Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryDelayedCokingYieldBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryDelayedCokingYieldBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryDelayedCokingYieldBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable screening-level delayed-coking product-yield balance.

The calculation converts a caller-selected fraction of a residue feed and allocates the converted feed among gas, naphtha, light coker gas oil, heavy coker gas oil, and petroleum coke. It is an algebraic scenario receipt, not a kinetic, furnace, coke-drum, cycle-time, fractionation, or product-property model.

1.0

    • calculate

      public static RefineryDelayedCokingYieldBalance calculate(double feedMassFlowKgPerHour, double conversionFraction, double gasMassFractionOfConvertedFeed, double naphthaMassFractionOfConvertedFeed, double lightCokerGasOilMassFractionOfConvertedFeed, double heavyCokerGasOilMassFractionOfConvertedFeed, double cokeMassFractionOfConvertedFeed)
      Calculate a five-lump delayed-coking converted-product balance plus unconverted residue.
      Parameters:
      feedMassFlowKgPerHour - residue feed mass flow in kg/h
      conversionFraction - fraction of residue feed converted, in [0, 1]
      gasMassFractionOfConvertedFeed - gas fraction of converted feed
      naphthaMassFractionOfConvertedFeed - naphtha fraction of converted feed
      lightCokerGasOilMassFractionOfConvertedFeed - light coker gas oil fraction
      heavyCokerGasOilMassFractionOfConvertedFeed - heavy coker gas oil fraction
      cokeMassFractionOfConvertedFeed - petroleum-coke fraction of converted feed
      Returns:
      immutable delayed-coking yield receipt
